note: Starting points, not finished documents. Fill them in here, have them approved, then record each in Policies. The control numbers are SAMA's; every word is ours.

documents.title: Cyber Security Governance and Committee Charter
documents.about: How cyber security is directed and controlled: the board, the committee, the CISO and the cyber security function.

documents.title: Cyber Security Strategy
documents.about: Why cyber security matters, where the organisation wants to be, and the initiatives that will take it there.

documents.title: Cyber Security Policy
documents.about: The organisation's commitment to cyber security, its objectives, and the rules everyone follows.

documents.title: Cyber Security Roles and Responsibilities
documents.about: Who is responsible for what in cyber security, how the CISO is appointed, and what goes into job descriptions.

documents.title: Cyber Security in Project Management
documents.about: How security is built into every project, from start to finish.

documents.title: Cyber Security Awareness Programme
documents.about: How staff, third parties and customers are made aware of cyber security, and how that is measured.

documents.title: Cyber Security Training Plan
documents.about: What training each group of people needs, how it is recorded and how it is checked.

documents.title: Cyber Security Risk Management Process
documents.about: How cyber security risks are found, rated, treated and monitored, and the risk appetite set by the board.

documents.title: Regulatory Compliance Process and Register
documents.about: How regulations and mandatory standards are found, communicated and complied with, and the register that records them.

documents.title: Cyber Security Review and Penetration Testing
documents.about: How critical assets and internet-facing services are reviewed and penetration tested, and how findings are followed up.

documents.title: Cyber Security Audit Plan
documents.about: How independent cyber security audits are planned, carried out and followed up.

documents.title: Human Resources Cyber Security
documents.about: Security requirements for recruiting, employing, moving and releasing staff.

documents.title: Physical Security
documents.about: How facilities that host information assets are protected from unauthorised physical access.

documents.title: Asset Management
documents.about: One register of every information asset, with owners, classification and handling rules.

documents.title: Cyber Security Architecture
documents.about: The security capabilities the organisation needs and the principles for building security in.

documents.title: Identity and Access Management Policy
documents.about: Who gets access to what, how it is requested, approved, reviewed and removed.

documents.title: Application Security Standard and Secure Development
documents.about: Security rules for applications and the secure development life cycle.

documents.title: Change Management
documents.about: How every change to information assets is assessed, tested, approved and reversed if needed.

documents.title: Infrastructure Security Standard
documents.about: Security rules for servers, networks, endpoints and other infrastructure in all sites.

documents.title: Cryptography Standard
documents.about: Approved encryption, when it must be used, and how keys are managed through their life.

documents.title: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Standard
documents.about: Rules for using personal devices for business information.

documents.title: Secure Disposal of Information Assets
documents.about: How information assets are destroyed so that nothing can be recovered.

documents.title: Payment Systems Security Standard
documents.about: Security rules for the shared payment systems (SARIE and Mada). For banks and payment participants.

documents.title: Electronic Banking Security Standard
documents.about: Security rules for online, mobile and phone banking, ATMs and notifications. For banks.

documents.title: Cyber Security Event Management and Monitoring
documents.about: How security events are monitored, analysed and handled around the clock.

documents.title: Cyber Security Incident Management
documents.about: How incidents are classified, handled, reported to SAMA and learned from.

documents.title: Threat Intelligence Management
documents.about: How threats are collected, analysed, acted on and shared.

documents.title: Vulnerability Management
documents.about: How vulnerabilities are found, classified, fixed within set times, and reported.

documents.title: Contract and Vendor Management
documents.about: Security requirements before, during and at the end of a contract with a vendor.

documents.title: Outsourcing Policy
documents.about: Security requirements before, during and after outsourcing, including SAMA's approval.

documents.title: Cloud Computing Policy
documents.about: Security controls for hybrid and public cloud services, including SAMA's approval.

documents.title: SAMA Approvals and Reporting Register
documents.about: What must be approved by SAMA before you act, and what must be reported to SAMA.

documents.title: Cyber Security in Business Continuity
documents.about: How critical services are kept running or restored when a cyber security event strikes.

documents.title: Acceptable Use of Information Assets
documents.about: The everyday rules for using the organisation's information, devices and systems.
